notes: Eight real-length tests of 20 (test IDs 23001-23008, 4/2/3/3/2/2/1/3, Tigertest's split: the PSP publishes no topic weights). 160 items in tests, the last items of each pool (40 in all) training-only. passPct 50 = 10 of 20, the real rule (Despacho 8270/2019, Anexo, art. 8.º n.º 5). Categories follow the base module (BAS01-BAS06, UFCD 4478 and 4798) and the vigilante module (VIG01-VIG07, ALM01, ALM02) of Portaria 148/2014. Four topic sets 23001-23004 (56/48/60/36) + 8 tests = 12 dashboard steps.
